component.name: Voxa
component.summary: Your personal voice assistant: dictation and local AI

description.p: Voxa records from your microphone, transcribes speech locally with Faster Whisper, sends prompts to a local Ollama model, and reads responses aloud with a natural neural voice and an offline eSpeak NG fallback. Wake it by name, talk freely, and it answers in its own voice.
The interface follows the system GTK and libadwaita theme, supports Wayland and X11, and uses PipeWire or PulseAudio through GStreamer.

screenshot.caption: Voice transcription and a streamed local AI response in dark mode

description.p: Voice2Text AI is now Voxa, a personal voice assistant: say "Voxa" to start a conversation, ask away, and get spoken answers from your local model. The app identity, window, menu, and assistant persona all carry the new name.
New Flatpak application ID: io.github.crhy.voxa (previously io.github.crhy.voice2textai). Existing installs keep running; import and install the new bundle to move to Voxa.

Settings moved from ~/.config/voice2text-ai to ~/.config/voxa — existing settings are carried over automatically on first start. The bundled backup tool is now voxa-backup (previously v2t-backup); archives created by older versions restore correctly with paths adjusted to the new location.
The default wake word for conversation mode is now "voxa" (change it in Preferences → Conversation if you prefer something else).

Hands-free conversation is now a real assistant loop: the model remembers earlier turns of the exchange (sent as a chat history), you can talk over a spoken reply to interrupt it and keep talking, and "cancel" or "goodbye" ends the conversation by voice.
A model picker in the main window and a page-per-topic Preferences layout, plus a GPU utilization gauge that stays visible for the app's lifetime.

Backup and restore of Ollama models, settings, and OpenCode configuration: encrypted, integrity-checked archives with a versioned manifest, default redaction of secrets, selective restore, and a newer-configuration guard that never silently overwrites.
Hardware-aware model suggestions sized to your GPU VRAM, one-click Ollama install, and in-app model management; live model discovery from Ollama's library.
Efficiency improvements: faster audio level metering and transcription probes, batched AI response rendering, quieter eSpeak fallback startup, and more robust streaming for newer Ollama servers.
Introduces a metallic microphone-and-waveform medallion that matches the Spaced Linux visual family while remaining distinct and recognizable at application-icon sizes.
Rebuilt the CUDA runtime with an OSTree-safe cuBLAS release so the Flatpak can be imported, installed, and mirrored by current Flatpak repositories.
Faster GPU dictation by probing the CUDA compute stack before loading, bundling the CUDA runtime libraries, and stopping the speaking indicator when speech finishes.
Rebuilt around GTK 4, libadwaita, and GStreamer with a modular, lower-overhead runtime.
